items.name: Mattresses
items.description: Orthopedic, memory foam and hybrid mattresses engineered for restorative sleep. Available in single, queen and king sizes with firmness options suited to family bedrooms and hotel-grade nightly turnover alike.
items.shortDescription: Orthopaedic, memory-foam and hybrid mattresses built for nightly use.
items.material: High-density PU foam, cooling memory foam and pocket-spring cores, finished with a quilted knit or damask cover.
items.care: Rotate head-to-toe every three months. Spot clean only — never soak. Use a mattress protector in guest rooms.
highlights: Firmness graded soft, medium and firm so guest rooms can be matched room by room
Pocket-spring options isolate movement — a practical choice for shared beds
Breathable covers suited to Pokhara's humid monsoon months
Bulk pricing and staged delivery available for hotel refits

items.name: Bedsheets
items.description: Fine cotton and premium cotton-blend bedsheets in timeless weaves — crisp percale for hotel freshness, or soft sateen for a cosier home feel, in a refined, easy-to-coordinate colour palette.
items.shortDescription: Percale and sateen bedsheet sets in hotel-grade cotton.
items.material: 200–300 thread-count long-staple cotton and cotton-rich blends. Percale for a crisp, cool hand; sateen for a softer sheen.
items.care: Machine wash warm with like colours. Tumble dry low. Wash before first use to set the weave.
highlights: Sold as fitted sheet, flat sheet and pillowcase sets, or as individual replacements
Deep-pocket fitted sheets stay put on thicker hotel mattresses
Colour-fast dyes hold up to repeated commercial laundering
Neutral palette designed to coordinate across an entire property

items.name: Duvets
items.description: Plush, temperature-balanced duvets and comforters in a range of warmth ratings, from light all-season options for guest rooms to heavier fills for Pokhara's cooler winter months at home.
items.shortDescription: Temperature-balanced duvets, comforters and protective covers.
items.material: Microfibre and down-alternative fills in a cotton cambric shell, baffle-box stitched to stop the filling migrating.
items.care: Use a washable duvet cover. Air regularly; professional cleaning once a season.
highlights: All-season and winter weights — the heavier fill suits Pokhara's cooler months
Hypoallergenic fills, an easy default for guest rooms
Baffle-box construction keeps loft even after repeated washing
Matching covers available in the bedsheet palette

items.name: Pillows & Covers
items.description: Supportive pillows in soft, medium and firm fills, paired with elegant covers — sized and finished to hotel housekeeping standards or a softer, personal touch for the home.
items.shortDescription: Fibre, memory-foam and latex pillows with protective covers.
items.material: Siliconised hollow-fibre, moulded memory foam and natural latex in cotton casings.
items.care: Fibre pillows are machine washable; foam and latex should be spot cleaned and aired.
highlights: Soft, medium and firm lofts so guests can be offered a pillow menu
Zippered protectors extend pillow life in high-turnover rooms
Memory foam holds neck support through the night
Bolsters and decorative cushions available to match soft furnishings

items.name: Curtains
items.description: Statement drapery in silk, velvet and linen, made to measure for every window — blackout linings available for guest rooms, and lighter sheers for airy living spaces at home.
items.shortDescription: Made-to-measure drapery in silk, velvet, linen and sheer weaves.
items.material: Faux silk, cotton-linen, velvet and polyester sheers, with optional blackout or dim-out lining.
items.care: Vacuum on a low setting monthly. Dry clean lined and velvet panels; wash unlined cotton cool.
highlights: Measured, stitched and installed by our own team
Blackout linings for guest rooms; light-filtering sheers for living spaces
Pinch pleat, eyelet, rod pocket and wave headings
Coordinated with tracks, rods and tie-backs from the same range

items.name: Curtain Tracks & Rods
items.description: Motorised and manual tracks, poles and finials in brushed brass, matte black and wood finishes — sized for large hotel window walls or fitted neatly into a single home window.
items.shortDescription: Motorised and manual tracks, poles and finials.
items.material: Powder-coated aluminium tracks and steel poles in brushed brass, matte black and wood finishes.
items.care: Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep tracks free of dust so gliders run smoothly.
highlights: Motorised tracks with remote or wall switch for tall hotel window walls
Ceiling and wall mounting, including bay and corner runs
Silent glide systems — worth it in bedrooms
Finish-matched brackets, finials and tie-back hooks

items.name: Carpets
items.description: Hand-selected wall-to-wall and area carpets in durable, high-traffic weaves for hotel corridors and lobbies, or softer pile options that anchor a living room at home.
items.shortDescription: Wall-to-wall and area carpets in high-traffic commercial weaves.
items.material: Solution-dyed nylon, polypropylene and wool-blend piles over a felt or rubber backing.
items.care: Vacuum twice weekly in busy areas. Professional hot-water extraction once or twice a year.
highlights: Commercial-rated piles that hold up in corridors and lobbies
Stain-resistant treatments as standard on synthetic ranges
Fitted, seamed and finished on site by our installers
Softer wool blends for bedrooms and living rooms at home

items.name: Blinds
items.description: Roller, roman and venetian blinds in blackout, dim-out and light-filtering fabrics — balancing natural light with privacy for both guest rooms and home offices.
items.shortDescription: Roller, roman, venetian and zebra blinds in blackout and light-filtering fabrics.
items.material: Polyester screen fabrics, PVC and aluminium slats, and wood-look composite venetians.
items.care: Dust slats regularly; wipe fabric blinds with a barely damp cloth.
highlights: Blackout, dim-out and sunscreen fabrics to suit the room's use
Chain, cord and motorised controls
Child-safe fittings available — worth specifying for family homes
Compact stack, useful where curtains would crowd the window

items.name: Rugs
items.description: Artisanal area rugs in wool, jute and synthetic blends, chosen for character underfoot in a lobby seating area or as the finishing layer in a family living room.
items.shortDescription: Hand-knotted and machine-woven rugs that anchor a room.
items.material: Wool, viscose-blend and durable polypropylene pile in hand-knotted and power-loomed constructions.
items.care: Rotate twice a year for even wear. Professional cleaning; blot spills immediately.
highlights: Traditional Nepali motifs alongside plain and abstract modern designs
Hand-knotted wool for reception areas that need to make an impression
Easy-clean synthetic options for family rooms
Custom sizes and shapes cut to order

items.name: Sofa & Cushion Covers
items.description: Tailored, washable sofa and cushion covers that refresh a lobby lounge or living room instantly — a practical way for hotels to protect upholstery between deep cleans.
items.shortDescription: Tailored sofa, chair and cushion covers, including full reupholstery.
items.material: Cotton-linen, chenille, velvet and performance weaves with soil-resistant finishes.
items.care: Removable covers wash cool and line dry. Fixed upholstery should be professionally cleaned.
highlights: Loose covers or complete reupholstery of existing frames
Performance fabrics that survive lobby and restaurant use
Piping, welt and contrast trims to your specification
Cushion inserts in feather and hollow-fibre fills

items.name: Table Linen & Kitchen Textiles
items.description: Tablecloths, runners, napkins and kitchen textiles in durable, easy-care fabrics — set for a hotel breakfast room or dressed simply for everyday family dining.
items.shortDescription: Tablecloths, runners, napkins and kitchen textiles for daily service.
items.material: Spun polyester and cotton-rich blends with soil-release finishes; damask weaves for banqueting.
items.care: Wash hot with an oxygen-based stain remover. Tumble dry low; press while slightly damp.
highlights: Sized for round, rectangular and banquet tables
Soil-release finishes lift food and oil stains in a normal wash
Matching napkins, runners and skirting for events
Aprons, oven gloves and kitchen cloths in the same range

items.name: Towels
items.description: Spa-grade, highly absorbent cotton towels in bath, hand and face sizes, woven for the repeated wash cycles of hotel laundry while staying soft enough for daily home use.
items.shortDescription: Absorbent cotton towels in weights from guest bath to pool.
items.material: 500–650 GSM ring-spun and combed cotton, double-stitched hems, low-lint finish.
items.care: Wash warm without fabric softener — softener coats the pile and cuts absorbency.
highlights: GSM graded so bath, hand, face and pool towels can be specified separately
Colour-fast and chlorine-resistant options for pool and spa areas
Reinforced hems built for commercial laundry cycles
Bath mats and pool towels available to match

items.name: Bath Robes & Slippers
items.description: Waffle-weave and terry bath robes with matching slippers — a signature guest amenity for resorts and boutique hotels, also available for a spa-style touch at home.
items.shortDescription: Waffle and terry robes with disposable or reusable slippers.
items.material: Cotton terry, velour and lightweight waffle weave; slippers in cotton terry and coral fleece.
items.care: Wash robes warm; avoid softener on terry. Reusable slippers wash cool in a laundry bag.
highlights: Waffle robes for warmer months, terry for winter and spa use
Unisex sizing with adjustable belts keeps stockholding simple
Open-toe and closed-toe slippers, disposable or reusable
Embroidery available for property branding

items.name: Hotel Furnishings
items.description: Complete furnishing packages for hotels and resorts — mattresses to linens, curtains to carpets — coordinated by room type and delivered turnkey, floor by floor.
items.shortDescription: Room-ready furnishing packages specified and installed per property.
items.material: Coordinated textile and furniture packages sourced to your brief and budget.
items.care: Care guidance is supplied per item as part of the handover pack.
highlights: Whole-room packages — bed, linen, window treatment, flooring and soft furnishings
Consistent specification across every room in a property
Phased delivery so floors can be refitted without closing the hotel
Single point of contact from specification through installation
